_about: The house's naming preferences: how a library's components, parts and properties are named (figma-standard rules 8, 9, 18, 20, 21). They are preferences, not defects: a name that departs from one works, it only reads unlike the rest, so an audit files it in the preference tier. Every tool that writes or reads a name takes them from here (merged by tools/snapshot/projects.cjs auditContext); a project overrides any of them in its context document's `naming-preferences` block. keys: what each means and the rule it serves; tools/toolkit-check/check-standards.mjs refuses one unregistered or read by nothing.

keys.groupSeparator: separator between equivalent siblings of one part (figma-standard rule 20)
keys.familySeparator: separator between a family and its part (figma-standard rule 9)
keys.internalPrefix: prefix of a part that does not publish (figma-standard rule 8)
keys.propertyCase: case every property name is written in: sentence (figma-standard rule 18)
keys.booleanPrefix: prefix every boolean property starts with (figma-standard rule 21)
keys.textPropertyAvoid: suffix a text property does not end with (figma-standard rule 21)
keys.textPropertyExceptions: text property names allowed to end with textPropertyAvoid, matching a code prop (figma-standard rule 21)
keys.swapAvoid: suffix an instance swap does not end with (figma-standard rule 21)
